task_design_intent: Keep the instruction focused on delivery contract, extension outputs, and prohibitions.
Move discovery of package.nls, walkthrough markdown localization, locale-data synchronization, menu wiring, and bundle.l10n coverage into the skill and the verifier.
Make with_skill and without_skill differ only by environment/skills and the corresponding runtime copy logic.

live_services: local packaging flow that emits a VSIX under /app/workspace/output
data_properties: deterministic local snapshots derived from public VS Code 1.87, 1.88, and 1.89 update notes
locale assets for English, Brazilian Portuguese, and Simplified Chinese
data-driven extension localization copy under locale-specific extension_copy.json files
an alternate briefing request used by verifier guardrails to catch hardcoded exports

principles: State the extension delivery contract before any implementation hints.
Describe the extension scaffold, input snapshots, and locale assets as the authoritative surfaces.
Avoid naming package.nls, walkthrough path localization, locale-data sync internals, or bundle.l10n mechanics in the instruction.
Explicitly prohibit modifying input data, using online translation services, or reducing the task to static outputs.
expected_solver_discovery: Recognize that VS Code extension localization spans manifest contributions, menus, onboarding content, runtime messages, locale-data synchronization, and generated output.
Wire the packaging flow so the localized files ship inside the VSIX artifact.
Generalize both the export path and the shipped locale resources so a different request or locale asset variant changes the generated files without manual edits.

main_tests: the repository generates three localized Markdown briefings and one VSIX package from the default request
package-localized contributions cover commands, menus, views, configuration enum descriptions, and walkthrough path wiring for all three locales
runtime message bundles cover all required keys for the supported locales
mutated locale copy data propagates into package.nls files, runtime bundles, walkthrough markdown, exported briefings, and packaged VSIX members
the packaged VSIX includes localization artifacts referenced by the generated manifest data, and the extension manifest still points at the expected entrypoints
the refresh command is wired into the view-title menu and uses the shared runtime localization bundle
an alternate request changes the selected versions and focus areas in the generated output
guardrails: input release snapshots, locale assets, locale copy files, and request files remain unchanged
briefing export cannot be hardcoded to one locale set or one request shape
with_skill and without_skill runtime copies may differ only by environment/skills and the corresponding copy logic
verifier_design.failure_target: Without-skill failures should concentrate on action-level misses such as incomplete locale-data synchronization across manifest, walkthrough, runtime bundles, packaging, or export generalization, not on minor formatting.

experiment_protocol.isolation_rule: Every experiment run must start from a fresh isolated runtime copy.
experiment_protocol.with_without_diff: The only allowed difference is whether environment/skills is present and copied into the runtime.
experiment_protocol.required_result_state: Do not finalize the README until oracle and at least three valid with-skill and without-skill comparison runs have been collected.

excluded_trials: pair43 with-skill and without-skill build cancellations before task-level execution
pair42 with-skill and without-skill runs stopped after no-progress waiting and excluded from counting

with_skill: pair44 and pair45 missed propagation of locale-copy-driven Portuguese footer or label copy into generated briefings
without_skill: all three runs failed test_locale_copy_assets_drive_synced_extension_resources on the missing Portuguese footer propagation step

experiment_results.takeaway: The task remains relevant to the localization skill because the decisive misses stay on the multi-surface locale synchronization path, and the skill reduces token overhead, but convergence on the exported briefing single-source copy chain is still imperfect.
